description: Integration manifest for IDEs. Lists the installable engine builds, where to copy each into a project, and the post-install steps. The IDE reads this, offers the engines to the user, then copies the chosen build's contents into the project.

engines.summary: Manual QA team for Claude Code — test-lead + qa-engineer + strategist agents, 12 slash commands, 31 ISTQB-grounded skills, Stop hooks, bundled sequential-thinking MCP.
postInstall: Enable the plugin for the project (or fully restart Claude Code so it discovers the dropped folder).
Run /setup to bootstrap .tms/memory/ and wire source-of-truth MCP servers.
verify: /help lists: setup, new-feature, update-feature, audit, brainstorm, pull-context, review-spec, risk-assess, test-plan, analyze-cases, traceability, save-memory
/hooks shows one PostToolUse hook (case-counter sync) and two Stop hooks (debug log + memory checkpoint)

engines.summary: Manual QA team for Codex — project-scoped subagents (.codex/agents/*.toml), 12 custom prompts (.codex/prompts/), AGENTS.md operating manual, 31 skills, Stop hooks.
postInstall: Codex auto-loads .codex/agents/*.toml as project-scoped subagents and concatenates AGENTS.md into its instructions.
verify: AGENTS.md, skills/, hooks/hooks.json are present at the project root

notes.source: Paths are relative to the repository root. dist/<engine> is a committed, self-contained build produced by scripts/build.{ps1,sh} from shared/ + engines/<engine>/.
notes.copy: 'contents' means copy everything inside `source` into `target` (do not nest the source folder itself). For the codex engine target '.', that means merging the build into the project root.
notes.empty: An 'empty project' choice is a no-op for this manifest — copy nothing.
